summary: story-010 (empty-pool-only setYieldStrategy gate) is FAITHFULLY implemented and its intended design is SAFE (Law-1 override clears). The new require at line 228 delivers exactly the guarantee the story+CLAUDE.md state, and the phantom-zero-staker brick PATTERN-001 worried about cannot arise (no path inserts a zero-amount staker). One real Law-2 deviation remains: the function-level NatSpec on setYieldStrategy (L204-214) and finalizeAndReset (L580-583) still describes the pre-gate in-place-drain behavior, contradicting the gate that the same commit advertises in CLAUDE.md. This is doc-lie staleness (F-01) at QA severity, no security/value impact. Ledger ss9f3 (CLAUDE.md doc-lag) IS resolved by the 125f585 CLAUDE.md rewrite; ss9l1 is untouched by this range.

findings.specText: story-010 (125f585): "CLAUDE.md: replace soft drain-first advice with hard empty-pool gate invariant"; CLAUDE.md now states: "setYieldStrategy reverts (\"StableStaker: pool not empty\") unless totalStaked == 0 — strategy (un)wiring is an empty-pool-only operation." The in-code intent comment at L221-227 agrees: "Strategy (un)wiring is an EMPTY-POOL-only operation ... Principal may only move through the realize-once-and-socialize terminal-migration path."
findings.specSource: git commit 125f585 body + lib/stable-staker/CLAUDE.md (Yield strategies section) + in-code intent comment L221-227
findings.actualBehavior: The require(totalStaked == 0) at L228 is correct, but the FUNCTION-LEVEL NatSpec directly above it (L204-214) was not updated by the same commit. It still asserts the now-impossible in-place behavior: "the old strategy is best-effort drained ... The whole position therefore moves YS1->YS2 in this single call, with no per-user migration." That whole-position-move is structurally dead under the gate (the staked>0 drain branch at L248 is unreachable when totalStaked==0). Separately, finalizeAndReset NatSpec L580-583 still credits "story 008's underwater guard" as the thing that forbids in-place underwater swaps, when story-010's empty-pool gate is now the (stronger, earlier-firing) forbidder — the test commit itself notes "empty-pool gate fires before the M-06 underwater guard."
findings.deviation: Doc-lie: the function NatSpec describes behavior the gate has removed. A future operator reading the docstring (the contract's comments explicitly say they are written for the operator) would believe setYieldStrategy migrates a live position in place and that the underwater guard is the active gate, both false. CLAUDE.md was fixed in the same commit but the Solidity NatSpec was not — an internal contradiction within commit 125f585 itself.
findings.securityValueImpact: none — pure documentation staleness. The runtime gate is correct and strictly more restrictive; no value flow or invariant depends on the stale text. Confirms Tier-1 LOCAL-001. Not cross-referenced to any H/M.

nonFindings.subject: story-010 conformance (core gate)
nonFindings.detail: Acceptance criterion from CLAUDE.md/commit body: setYieldStrategy must revert 'StableStaker: pool not empty' unless totalStaked==0, forcing strategy rotation onto the terminal-migration runbook. Code at L228 enforces exactly this, after the pre-existing Active check (L220), before any external call or strategy write. The story's choice of predicate (totalStaked==0, 'no principal') vs ('no stakers', stakerCount==0) is benign: stake/depositFor both require amount>0 (L290, L622) so no zero-amount staker is ever inserted, and every drop-to-zero path removes from _stakers (L324-325, L365, L537). Therefore totalStaked==0 ⟺ stakerCount==0 in all conforming flows (Tier-1 G-1/G-2 verified). The gate's totalStaked-only check is equivalent to finalizeAndReset's two-condition check; the asymmetry is cosmetic.

nonFindings.subject: Law-1 override — is story-010's intended design itself safe?
nonFindings.detail: story-010 forces a full terminal-migration cycle (initiateMigration → batchMigrate/userMigrate → finalizeAndReset → setYieldStrategy) instead of in-place swaps. This is strictly MORE restrictive than the prior behavior and removes (does not add) reachable behavior; it collapses the in-place-principal-move root cause shared by M-01/M-06/M-07. PATTERN-001's phantom-zero-staker brick of finalizeAndReset does NOT materialize: there is no code path that inserts a staker into _stakers with amount==0 (stake L290 and depositFor L622 both require amount>0), so finalizeAndReset's stakerCount==0 precondition cannot be held hostage by a zero-amount ghost position — stakerCount==0 ⟺ totalStaked==0. The revival path returns an empty pool to Active, after which the gate passes trivially (Tier-1 G-4). No new hazard is introduced by the story's intended behavior.
